study.question: Can reducing transient history-summary workspace and discarded coefficient computation lower prediction cost while preserving native96 click AUC, after recent learned-capacity reductions failed utility?
study.hypothesis: Observed: native96 reproduces click AUC 0.6675003890552496 across rounds66-68. Rank88 factors, collapsed dense96, and item-ID12 learned/fixed/direct variants give 0.6671251297972951, 0.6672329669369609, 0.6670237510876471, 0.6670156484292077 and 0.6669902167355686 respectively; these bounded unsuccessful reductions do not refute every smaller model. In round68 native versus direct12 p50 latency was15.16815 versus15.27790ms and inference28.08852 versus28.61921s despite saving3,387,248 parameters. Fixed16 identity GEMM also changed AUC to0.6674169548906408: BF16 execution matters. Native source instead materializes [B,10,5,112] block summaries then sums blocks, and computes several normalized coefficient outputs discarded by its constructor-fixed branches. This is an observed source-level cost opportunity, not a measured bottleneck. Local agent-memory searches for capacity/summary returned no records; authorized trial receipts and source are the evidence. No failed executions are listed in the authorized trajectory index; unsuccessful scientific branches are retained separately from execution failure. Mechanism hypothesis: a global five-by100 contraction can replace ten five-by10 contractions plus block reduction, and fixed-mode dead-work elimination can remove kernels without removing a live statistic. Training stays identical; global evaluation changes summation/BF16 rounding. Either may fail on kernel efficiency or unchanged bottlenecks. Prospective gates, fixed before these variants are scored: global-contraction cells must have full-validation click AUC >= contemporaneous native control minus0.0001, and >=0.6674003890552496 (archived native96 minus0.0001), and >=0.666653547526167 (topic entry minus0.0001). Live-only is an equivalence control/candidate: AUC difference above1e-6 or unequal predictions at a fixed state requires correctness investigation, not relaxed selection. Utility additionally requires model-only p50 at least2% below contemporaneous native, p95 no more than2% worse, and full-validation inference no more than2% worse. All three changed cells are prespecified eligible if their applicable gates pass. Rank eligible cells by lowest p50, breaking differences under1% by lower p95 then higher click AUC. No selection from auxiliary mean. A single timed pass is provisional; repeat supported direction before an efficiency claim. If no cell meets gates, retain incumbent and report a null result. This study holds representational/parameter capacity fixed and reduces temporary prediction workspace/unused computation; it cannot demonstrate redundant learned capacity.

Live-only is an equivalence control/candidate: AUC difference above1e-6 or unequal predictions at a fixed state requires correctness investigation, not relaxed selection. Utility additionally requires model-only p50 at least2% below contemporaneous native, p95 no more than2% worse, and full-validation inference no more than2% worse. All three changed cells are prespecified eligible if their applicable gates pass. Rank eligible cells by lowest p50, breaking differences under1% by lower p95 then higher click AUC. No selection from auxiliary mean. A single timed pass is provisional; repeat supported direction before an efficiency claim. If no cell meets gates, retain incumbent and report a null result. This study holds representational/parameter capacity fixed and reduces temporary prediction workspace/unused computation; it cannot demonstrate redundant learned capacity.
predictions: Parameters/optimizer storage and training trajectory remain unchanged; training-time speed reduction is not predicted. Native reproduction failure is a prerequisite issue, not counterevidence to the mechanism.

Global contraction has unchanged nominal summary MAC count B*5*100*112 but reduces its bmm output from B*50*112 to B*5*112 elements. For B8192, BF16 output drops from87.5MiB to8.75MiB (78.75MiB less); extra transposed coefficient storage/casts and other live tensors mean this is NOT a predicted peak-memory saving. MAC equality and lower temporary output alone do not imply lower latency.

Live-only removes dead tensor normalizations/duplicate products while preserving every support predicate and live arithmetic expression. Fixed-state outputs should match reference; only measured latency can establish cost utility.

Global cells can exhibit BF16 rounding differences despite real-arithmetic equality; full click AUC must pass the predeclared gates. Factorial timing/quality differences will reveal any interaction. Report full four-task tradeoffs, including inherited auxiliary quality loss versus DIN; this is click-selected utility.

If both factors help independently, combined may have lowest measured latency, but this is unverified. One seed/pass gives preliminary support only; later matched seeds and timings are required if the direction matters.
falsifiers: Global cells below the frozen AUC floor or contemporaneous noninferiority margin reject utility of that implementation; do not relax threshold after observation.
No changed cell reaching the2% p50 gate with p95/full-inference safeguards rejects practical prediction-cost utility under this device/batch protocol, even if symbolic workspace decreases.

Live-only numerical change, changed training updates, changed gates/masking/ownership, new model state, or incorrect event order invalidates the intended control and requires a corrected implementation with charged cost. This is not scientific evidence against arithmetic coalescing.
Loss of peak-memory advantage after coefficient copy or slower larger reduction is admissible negative evidence. Null results limit these execution choices, not all possible capacity reductions.
alternative_explanations: Latency noise/host loading/kernel scheduling or device contention; archived timing drift is visible and cannot establish speedup
BF16 reduction length/order, coefficient transpose materialization/casts or tensor-core kernel choice rather than changed information or model capacity
Other representation/scorer work dominates total latency; saved dead-work kernels and contraction memory may be too small to matter
Selection from many historical variants and one seed may exaggerate quality; repeated same seed checks reproducibility only, not independent mechanism support
Inherited click-versus-auxiliary quality tradeoffs and official_offline delayed-action visibility limit deployment interpretation
